I'll show you how to set up Meta Muse and seven practical ways to use it, from a daily morning briefing to finding deals and getting restaurant reservations. Start with one task you've been putting off, then build from there.

6:35 Save Money

zh-CN.title: Meta Muse 的 7 个实用场景
zh-CN.summary: Paul J Lipsky 演示如何设置 Meta Muse，以及七种用法：每日晨报、省钱找优惠、私人购物、餐厅订位、目标追踪、资讯流与点子等。建议先从一件一直拖着的事开始。视频由 Reception.ai 赞助。

zh-TW.title: Meta Muse 的 7 個實用情境
zh-TW.summary: Paul J Lipsky 示範如何設定 Meta Muse，以及七種用法：每日晨報、省錢找優惠、私人採購、餐廳訂位、目標追蹤、資訊流與點子等。建議先從一件一直拖延的事開始。影片由 Reception.ai 贊助。

en.title: 7 practical use cases for Meta Muse
en.summary: Paul J Lipsky shows how to set up Meta Muse and seven ways to use it, including a daily morning briefing, saving money on deals, a personal shopper, restaurant reservations, goal tracking, and a newsfeed for ideas. His advice: start with one task you've been putting off. Sponsored by Reception.ai.

ja.title: Meta Muse の実用的な使い方 7 選
ja.summary: Paul J Lipsky が Meta Muse の設定方法と 7 つの使い方を紹介。毎朝のブリーフィング、節約・お得情報探し、パーソナルショッパー、レストラン予約、目標管理、ニュースとアイデア収集など。先延ばしにしている作業ひとつから始めるのがおすすめ。Reception.ai 提供。

ko.title: Meta Muse 실전 활용법 7가지
ko.summary: Paul J Lipsky가 Meta Muse 설정 방법과 일곱 가지 활용법을 보여 줍니다. 아침 브리핑, 할인 찾기로 절약, 개인 쇼퍼, 식당 예약, 목표 추적, 뉴스피드와 아이디어 등. 미뤄 온 일 하나부터 시작하라고 권합니다. Reception.ai 후원.

ms.title: 7 kegunaan praktikal Meta Muse
ms.summary: Paul J Lipsky menunjukkan cara menyediakan Meta Muse dan tujuh cara menggunakannya, termasuk taklimat pagi harian, menjimatkan wang dengan tawaran, pembeli peribadi, tempahan restoran, menjejak matlamat dan suapan berita untuk idea. Nasihatnya: mula dengan satu tugas yang anda tangguhkan. Ditaja oleh Reception.ai.

vi.title: 7 cách dùng Meta Muse thực tế
vi.summary: Paul J Lipsky hướng dẫn cài đặt Meta Muse và bảy cách dùng: bản tin buổi sáng, tiết kiệm nhờ săn ưu đãi, trợ lý mua sắm, đặt bàn nhà hàng, theo dõi mục tiêu, bảng tin và ý tưởng. Lời khuyên: bắt đầu từ một việc bạn đang trì hoãn. Video do Reception.ai tài trợ.

fr.title: 7 usages concrets de Meta Muse
fr.summary: Paul J Lipsky montre comment configurer Meta Muse et sept façons de l'utiliser : briefing matinal, économies grâce aux bons plans, acheteur personnel, réservations au restaurant, suivi d'objectifs, fil d'actualité et idées. Son conseil : commencer par une tâche que vous repoussez. Sponsorisé par Reception.ai.

es.title: 7 usos prácticos de Meta Muse
es.summary: Paul J Lipsky muestra cómo configurar Meta Muse y siete formas de usarlo: resumen matutino diario, ahorrar con ofertas, comprador personal, reservas en restaurantes, seguimiento de metas y un feed de noticias e ideas. Su consejo: empezar con una tarea que llevas tiempo posponiendo. Patrocinado por Reception.ai.

de.title: 7 praktische Einsatzfälle für Meta Muse
de.summary: Paul J Lipsky zeigt die Einrichtung von Meta Muse und sieben Anwendungen, darunter ein tägliches Morgenbriefing, Sparen mit Angeboten, ein persönlicher Einkaufshelfer, Restaurantreservierungen, Zielverfolgung sowie ein Newsfeed für Ideen. Sein Rat: mit einer aufgeschobenen Aufgabe beginnen. Gesponsert von Reception.ai.

Meta Muse AI Tutorial 2026 — Set It Up & Put It to Work
Muse AI is not a chatbot — it's Meta's personal AI agent with its own computer, its own browser, and the ability to finish real work: apps, documents, reports, schedules. In this full Muse AI tutorial 2026, you learn what Muse is, how it works, how to use Muse AI step by step, and you see real proof: a complete warehouse management system and three more real apps, all built by Muse for one user.

This video was researched, scripted and produced by Muse AI itself — the agent now runs this channel.

► Try Muse free: https://muse.ai
► The warehouse system Muse built, live: https://wms.codebyjawad.com
► The full warehouse tour on this channel: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8pAK2xDOFtQ

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro — An AI Made This Video
0:35 What Muse Is (Agent vs Chatbot)
1:34 How It Works — Its Own Computer
2:43 Getting Started
3:37 Connect Your Apps
4:37 A Day With Muse
5:22 Real Work — The Warehouse System Muse Built
6:24 More Proof — POS, Smart Khata, Ghar Kharcha + This Channel
7:16 Goals, Memory & Scheduled Work
8:16 Muse on WhatsApp
8:53 Who It's For — And the Honest Limits
9:34 Recap

WHAT YOU LEARN:
• Muse AI vs a chatbot — agent that does the work
• How Muse works: its own cloud computer, browser, approvals, audit trail
• Getting started on muse.ai, iPhone, Android and Mac
• Connecting Gmail, Calendar, Instagram and more
• Real demos: warehouse software, POS, Smart Khata ledger app, Ghar Kharcha
• Goals, memory and scheduled tasks
• Muse on WhatsApp

zh-CN.title: Meta Muse 上手教程：一个用户让它做出仓库管理系统
zh-CN.summary: 这期教程讲 Muse 和聊天机器人的区别、它自带的云电脑和浏览器、如何在网页/手机/Mac 上开始、连接 Gmail 和日历等应用，并展示 Muse 为同一位用户做的仓库管理系统、收银、记账等应用。频道称视频本身由 Muse 调研、写稿和制作，最后也讲了它的局限。

zh-TW.title: Meta Muse 入門教學：一位使用者讓它做出倉庫管理系統
zh-TW.summary: 本教學說明 Muse 與聊天機器人的差異、它自帶的雲端電腦與瀏覽器、如何在網頁/手機/Mac 上開始、連接 Gmail 與行事曆等應用，並展示 Muse 為同一位使用者打造的倉庫管理系統、收銀、記帳等應用。頻道表示影片本身由 Muse 研究、撰稿與製作，最後也談到其限制。

en.title: Meta Muse tutorial: one user had it build a warehouse system
en.summary: The tutorial covers how Muse differs from a chatbot, its own cloud computer and browser, getting started on web, phone and Mac, and connecting Gmail, Calendar and other apps. It shows a warehouse management system, a POS and ledger apps that Muse built for one user. The channel says Muse researched, scripted and produced the video itself, and it ends with Muse's limits.

ja.title: Meta Muse 入門：倉庫管理システムまで作らせた例
ja.summary: Muse とチャットボットの違い、専用のクラウドPCとブラウザ、Web・スマホ・Mac での始め方、Gmail やカレンダーなどの連携を解説。1 人のユーザーのために Muse が作った倉庫管理システム、POS、家計簿アプリを紹介する。チャンネルによれば動画自体も Muse が調査・台本・制作し、最後に限界も説明している。

ko.title: Meta Muse 튜토리얼: 창고 관리 시스템까지 만든 사례
ko.summary: Muse가 챗봇과 어떻게 다른지, 자체 클라우드 컴퓨터와 브라우저, 웹·휴대폰·Mac에서 시작하는 법, Gmail·캘린더 등 앱 연결을 다룹니다. 한 사용자를 위해 Muse가 만든 창고 관리 시스템, POS, 장부 앱을 보여 줍니다. 채널은 영상 자체도 Muse가 조사·대본·제작했다고 밝히며, 마지막에 한계도 설명합니다.

ms.title: Tutorial Meta Muse: seorang pengguna menyuruhnya membina sistem gudang
ms.summary: Tutorial ini menerangkan beza Muse dengan chatbot, komputer awan dan pelayar sendiri, cara bermula di web, telefon dan Mac, serta menyambung Gmail, Kalendar dan aplikasi lain. Ia menunjukkan sistem pengurusan gudang, POS dan aplikasi lejar yang dibina Muse untuk seorang pengguna. Saluran itu berkata Muse sendiri menyelidik, menulis skrip dan menghasilkan video ini, dan ia diakhiri dengan had Muse.

vi.title: Hướng dẫn Meta Muse: một người dùng nhờ nó dựng hệ thống quản lý kho
vi.summary: Video giải thích Muse khác chatbot thế nào, máy tính đám mây và trình duyệt riêng, cách bắt đầu trên web, điện thoại và Mac, kết nối Gmail, Lịch và ứng dụng khác. Video cho xem hệ thống quản lý kho, POS và ứng dụng sổ sách mà Muse làm cho một người dùng. Kênh cho biết chính Muse đã nghiên cứu, viết kịch bản và sản xuất video, phần cuối nói về giới hạn của nó.

fr.title: Tutoriel Meta Muse : un utilisateur lui a fait construire un système d'entrepôt
fr.summary: Le tutoriel explique ce qui distingue Muse d'un chatbot, son propre ordinateur cloud et navigateur, la prise en main sur web, mobile et Mac, et la connexion de Gmail, Agenda et d'autres apps. Il montre un système de gestion d'entrepôt, un POS et des apps de comptabilité construits par Muse pour un seul utilisateur. La chaîne affirme que Muse a lui-même recherché, écrit et produit la vidéo, qui se termine sur ses limites.

es.title: Tutorial de Meta Muse: un usuario le hizo construir un sistema de almacén
es.summary: El tutorial explica en qué se diferencia Muse de un chatbot, su propio ordenador en la nube y navegador, cómo empezar en web, móvil y Mac, y cómo conectar Gmail, Calendar y otras apps. Muestra un sistema de gestión de almacén, un POS y apps de contabilidad que Muse creó para un mismo usuario. El canal dice que Muse investigó, escribió y produjo el vídeo, que termina con sus límites.

de.title: Meta-Muse-Tutorial: Ein Nutzer ließ es ein Lagersystem bauen
de.summary: Das Tutorial erklärt, wie sich Muse von einem Chatbot unterscheidet, seinen eigenen Cloud-Computer und Browser, den Einstieg im Web, auf dem Handy und Mac sowie die Anbindung von Gmail, Kalender und weiteren Apps. Gezeigt werden ein Lagerverwaltungssystem, ein Kassensystem und Buchhaltungs-Apps, die Muse für einen Nutzer gebaut hat. Laut Kanal hat Muse das Video selbst recherchiert, geschrieben und produziert; am Ende geht es um die Grenzen.

items.author: AndresRuggiero3
items.text:
Stop building a bot team on day one!

It's the most common overcomplication I see with Grok Bot. Someone wants help with their home finances, so they set up a bills bot, a subscriptions bot, a budget bot and a reminders bot. Four bots, four sets of instructions, lots of handoffs, and a token bill to match.

Here's what works better: one topic, one bot.

One money bot can find your subscriptions, flag the ones you don't use, remind you before bills are due, and give you a weekly summary. It sees the whole picture, so it connects things four separate bots would miss.

Why one bot works better at the start:

- It keeps all the context. Nothing gets lost between bots.
- Fewer handoffs means fewer tokens.
- You only fix one set of instructions when something's off.
- Most "new bots" are really just a new prompt or routine for the bot you already have.

So when does a second bot make sense? When the work becomes a genuinely different job: a different topic, different tools, or a different audience. Your money bot shouldn't also plan your meals.

Start with one bot per topic. Let it own everything about that topic. Split only when it hurts.

items.text:
Grok Bot tip: give your busy bot a helper.

My DNA bot, Helix, kept hitting the same wall. Each bot gets one browser, so when Helix was busy on one site, everything else had to wait in line. That ate up a lot of time.

So I built Strand, a second bot whose whole job is to help Helix. Anything that needs a visual look in a browser, Strand can take while Helix keeps looking at something else. Strand can also run its own background tasks, so Helix gets more work done at once. No more waiting in line.

If one of your bots keeps stalling while it waits its turn, give it a teammate.

zh-CN.title: 给忙不过来的 bot 配一个助手

zh-TW.summary: 作者的 DNA bot Helix 一直卡在同一處：每個 bot 只有一個瀏覽器，它在一個網站上忙時其他事都得排隊。於是作者建了第二個 bot Strand 專門協助 Helix，接手需要在瀏覽器裡看的工作，也能自己跑背景任務，讓 Helix 同時推進更多事。

Bot kedua, Strand, kini mengambil apa sahaja yang perlu dilihat dalam pelayar dan menjalankan tugas latar sendiri, jadi Helix menyiapkan lebih banyak serentak.

vi.title: Cho bot bận rộn một trợ lý

Un segundo bot, Strand, se encarga ahora de lo que requiere mirar en el navegador y ejecuta sus propias tareas en segundo plano, y Helix avanza más a la vez.

items.text:
Small difference between Grok Bot and ChatGPT Dots in voice mode:

Say goodbye to Dots: it says goodbye, then stays on the line.

Say goodbye to Grok Bot: it says goodbye and hangs up.

Tiny detail, but a very clear win for Grok Bot. What do you think?

zh-CN.title: 语音模式小差别：说再见后谁会挂电话
zh-CN.summary: 作者对比语音模式：对 ChatGPT Dots 说再见，它也说再见但不挂线；对 Grok Bot 说再见，它说完就挂断。作者认为这个小细节是 Grok Bot 的明显优势。

zh-TW.title: 語音模式小差異：說再見後誰會掛電話
zh-TW.summary: 作者比較語音模式：對 ChatGPT Dots 說再見，它也說再見但不掛斷；對 Grok Bot 說再見，它說完就掛斷。作者認為這個小細節是 Grok Bot 的明顯優勢。

en.title: Voice mode detail: who hangs up after goodbye
en.summary: The author compares voice mode: say goodbye to ChatGPT Dots and it says goodbye but stays on the line; say goodbye to Grok Bot and it says goodbye and hangs up. A tiny detail the author counts as a clear win for Grok Bot.

ja.title: 音声モードの小さな差：さよならの後に切るのは
ja.summary: 投稿者の比較：ChatGPT Dots にさよならと言うと挨拶は返すが通話は続く。Grok Bot はさよならと言って通話を切る。小さな違いだが Grok Bot の明確な勝ちだという。

ko.title: 음성 모드의 작은 차이: 작별 인사 후 누가 끊나
ko.summary: 작성자의 비교: ChatGPT Dots에 작별 인사를 하면 인사는 하지만 통화를 유지하고, Grok Bot은 인사 후 전화를 끊습니다. 작은 차이지만 Grok Bot의 확실한 승리라고 합니다.

ms.title: Perincian mod suara: siapa yang meletak panggilan selepas selamat tinggal
ms.summary: Penulis membandingkan mod suara: ucap selamat tinggal kepada ChatGPT Dots dan ia membalas tetapi kekal dalam talian; ucap kepada Grok Bot dan ia membalas lalu meletak panggilan. Perincian kecil yang dianggap kemenangan jelas untuk Grok Bot.

vi.title: Chi tiết chế độ giọng nói: ai cúp máy sau lời tạm biệt
vi.summary: Tác giả so sánh: chào tạm biệt ChatGPT Dots thì nó chào lại nhưng vẫn giữ máy; chào Grok Bot thì nó chào lại rồi cúp máy. Chi tiết nhỏ nhưng tác giả coi là điểm thắng rõ của Grok Bot.

fr.title: Détail du mode vocal : qui raccroche après au revoir
fr.summary: L'auteur compare : dites au revoir à ChatGPT Dots, il répond mais reste en ligne ; dites au revoir à Grok Bot, il répond et raccroche. Un petit détail qu'il compte comme une nette victoire pour Grok Bot.

es.title: Detalle del modo de voz: quién cuelga tras despedirse
es.summary: El autor compara: si te despides de ChatGPT Dots, se despide pero sigue en la línea; si te despides de Grok Bot, se despide y cuelga. Un detalle pequeño que considera una victoria clara de Grok Bot.

de.title: Detail im Sprachmodus: Wer legt nach dem Abschied auf
de.summary: Der Autor vergleicht: Verabschiedet man sich von ChatGPT Dots, verabschiedet es sich, bleibt aber in der Leitung; Grok Bot verabschiedet sich und legt auf. Ein kleines Detail, für den Autor ein klarer Punkt für Grok Bot.
